title: GGP-S03 Small Salvage Recovery Tender Thrust-Tower Production Reference

metadata.purpose: Canonical source-grounded ship, room-kit, DCC, and Unreal implementation contract
metadata.source_preservation: All v1, superseded, and generated source images remain unchanged and traceable.
metadata.coordinate_contract: The ship is a thrust-gravity vertical stack. +X is bow and up-stack, -X is aft toward engines and gravity-down, and every occupied floor is a transverse YZ slab with +X normal.
metadata.visual_presentation_contract: Canonical stack proofs show +X toward page top and -X engines toward page bottom. Room views are authored upright in local thrust gravity because their geometry, fixtures, and occupants all bear on the engine-facing floor.

source_sheet.notes: Visual authority for large room plans, sections, traversal splines, sockets, clearances, utility routes, overlays, and DCC mapping. This JSON is numeric authority.

supplemental_sheets.notes: Overrides perspective or angled engine depictions in every other raster sheet.

pivot.name: PIVOT_ShipRoot_AftCenter
pivot.rule: Aft engine-base center. Geometry extends toward +X. No export rotation.

parts.name: MODULE_EngineBase
parts.role: asymmetric aft main-drive base with straight parallel centerlines and a common nozzle plane

parts.name: MODULE_ManeuveringThrusters
parts.role: separate attitude, translation, and docking thrusters; never classified as main engines

parts.name: OVERLAY_Bloom
parts.role: separable contamination geometry, masks, decals, and VFX

room_story_construction.axis: +X from engine-facing floor toward next bowward deck

circulation_network.authority: Numeric route topology and engine integration contract. Runtime navigation remains pending until graybox traversal tests pass.

corridor_rules.rule: Corridors wrap around each room footprint and equipment island. Their offsets respond to local hull openings, pressure zones, maintenance clearances, and gameplay terminals.

interdeck_devices.failure_mode: disabled platform forces ladder or emergency-trunk reroute

unreal.nanite: Enable on opaque static hull and structural modules. Disable on translucent and deforming overlays.
unreal.collision: Authored simple collision by streamed hull partition. Separate walkable room and blocking hull channels.
unreal.import_policy: Import modules with aft-root pivot, +X forward, +Z display-up, no corrective rotation, and 1 m equals 100 uu.

requirements.rule: Root control preserves +X forward and -X gravity with no corrective parent rotation.
Animated service modules cannot own streamed hull partitions.
All room and prop animation remains authored in the ship local frame where gravity is -X.
False-signal animation cannot reveal deception through color, timing, or unique motion.
Each emitter belongs to the same streaming cell as its socket or spline segment.
False Bloom signals reuse clean-state rendering and do not receive a warning-color override.

unreal.representation: USplineComponent, scene-component sockets, and actor volumes

requirements.rule: Every traversal or utility spline crossing a room or pressure boundary receives a named socket.
Every traversal spline remains inside the matching clearance volume for its full length.
Every room has a primary walk route plus at least one alternate, service, vent, or emergency route.
Traversal and environment splines are separate assets, collections, components, and PCG tags.
Power, data, coolant, air, and vent splines expose break and reroute states per streaming cell.
False-signal Bloom uses normal clean-state signal color and presentation. Never recolor it to disclose deception.
Damage and Bloom remain separable from clean hull and from each other.

canonical_stack_proof.occupant_on_page: upright with boots on engine-facing floor and head toward +X

room_view.camera_relation: local gravity-upright view derived from the same vertical stack frame
room_view.floor_on_page: horizontal at bottom because the room geometry is correctly authored

forbidden: main nozzle outside common aft plane
floor not between occupant and engines
conventional axial corridor used as a room story
person pasted onto incorrectly oriented room

acceptance_checks.requirement: Gravity is -X toward the aft engine base; no Y or Z gravity remains in canonical data.
All habitable floor planes are YZ transverse slabs with +X normals.
Canonical proofs show a true vertical stack with floors between occupants and engines, and room views use the same local gravity frame.
Every main-engine centerline is parallel to X, every nozzle exits on the common aft plane, and no main engine can cant or gimbal.
Engine-bearing overview, story, Houdini, and Unreal panels use flat orthographic engines with straight centerlines and a level common aft plane.
Straight main engines differ in scale and YZ placement and have an off-origin centroid without using diagonal canting.
Five role rooms have unique archetypes, silhouettes, offsets, and landmarks; mirrored reuse is forbidden.
Every room links named walk, crouch, crawl, vent, and squeeze splines to sockets, clearance profiles, and volumes.
Every occupied band has a distinct YZ corridor topology and at least two +/-X interdeck methods across lifts, pressure stairs, service ladders, or the independent emergency trunk.
Exterior baselines and both from-scratch vertical-stack room sheets are linked while superseded images remain traceable.
Generate measured modules and verify aft-root transform, transverse slabs, and unique room footprints in Blender.
Import modules and validate PCG assembly, World Partition, HLOD, Nanite, collision, and data layers in Unreal.
Validate walk, crouch, crawl, vent, squeeze-gap, stair, ladder, lift, and emergency-trunk traversal using player suit profiles and route-failure states.
Meet frame, memory, streaming, light, and draw-call budgets in the target demo scene.
